newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures finish higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures finish higher.

text.p: Aug 27 - U.S. stock index futures finished higher in quiet trading, with most posting tight ranges. September S&P 500 futures ended near the day's peak in an inside day on bar charts, a sign of consolidation. Traders said market buoyant all day even amid flood of sales at 666.00 early. Resistance for Wednesday pegged at 667.25 and 669.00. Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
